overview: Credit Underwriting Evidence Assembly addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in banking and payments operations. The first proof of value uses application records, bureau extracts and verified income. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is manual underwriting hours per approved file, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: manual underwriting hours per approved file

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: application records, bureau extracts and verified income; define manual underwriting hours per approved file and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of Payments / Chief Risk Officer.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
